finalists.label: Ependymoma
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as a mildly hypodense mass lesion centered in the fourth ventricle region and gait ataxia that are not shared with its rivals.

finalists.label: Brain tumor
finalists.why: It is a broad category that encompasses the mass lesion in the fourth ventricle, but lacks specific details that would make it a stronger candidate than Ependymoma.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a mildly hypodense mass lesion centered in the fourth ventricle region and the absence of contrast enhancement or calcifications, along with gait ataxia, made Ependymoma a more specific and detailed diagnosis than the broader Brain tumor category.
